$comment: The multi_repo_split metrics event. Producer: ticket-pickup Step 3.5 (multi-repo detection), emitted on BOTH paths — after the gate resolves (mode 'gate') and on notice-only detection (mode 'notice'). Consumers: agent-stats (counts split by mode and gate_choice; the notice-vs-gate ratio is the detection false-positive denominator) and swarm-retro's quantitative analysis step. Enforcement lives in metrics-event.schema.json (event_type enum + data.oneOf branch); this file is the documentation and test point, validated by tests/multi-repo-split-event.bats. Uses `ticket` (the parent key), not `run_id` — the split is a per-ticket fact.

timestamp.$comment: ISO 8601 UTC. Optional at emit time — emit-metric.sh injects it when absent.

agent.$comment: Always ticket-pickup — the only producer of this event.

project.$comment: Basename of the git repo root where the pickup ran.

ticket.$comment: The PARENT ticket key (e.g. PROJ-1234) — the ticket the split decision was made on, not a created sub-task.

mode.$comment: 'gate' = detection had resolution evidence and the split gate was shown; 'notice' = signals detected but no registry / no resolution evidence / corroboration-only, so only a notice printed. Notice events are the false-positive denominator.

repos_detected.$comment: All repo names the detection surfaced, resolved or not.

repos_resolved.$comment: Subset of repos_detected that resolved to a registered local checkout.

repos_unresolved.$comment: Subset of repos_detected with no registry entry or a stale one — registry-gap signal.

gate_choice.$comment: The user's gate keypress: split / reorder / only / single / cancel. Null iff mode is 'notice' (no gate was shown); subtask_keys and final_order are empty arrays then.

subtask_keys.$comment: Jira keys of the per-repo sub-tasks created on a 'split'/'reorder' choice (e.g. PROJ-1235). Empty when no sub-tasks were created.

proposed_order.$comment: Repo names in the merge order the detection proposed (provider first).

final_order.$comment: Repo names in the merge order after the gate resolved. Empty when mode is 'notice'. On gate_choice 'cancel'/'only'/'single' emit final_order = proposed_order (no reorder happened); it differs from proposed_order only on 'reorder'.
